name: arr-command-center
description: A locally-hosted dashboard to manage Sonarr, Radarr, Overseerr/Seerr and SABnzbd behind Cloudflare Access. A self-hosted LunaSea replacement.

scripts.ios:build:sim: xcodebuild -workspace ios/App/App.xcworkspace -scheme App -sdk iphonesimulator -configuration Debug -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' -derivedDataPath ios/App/build CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO clean build
scripts.ios:archive: xcodebuild -workspace ios/App/App.xcworkspace -scheme App -configuration Release -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' -archivePath ios/App/build/ArrCommandCenter.xcarchive archive
